use_cases: Call-to-action buttons on landing pages where animated hover effects enhance user engagement and draw attention.
Navigation prompts in 404 or error pages where interactive elements guide users back to main content.
Modern web applications requiring polished micro-interactions without visual clutter.
Marketing websites and SaaS product pages needing distinctive button animations that feel premium.
Any interface element where a smooth expanding circle effect with icon animation improves visual hierarchy.
ai_summary: A minimalist animated button component featuring a smooth hover effect where an arrow slides from left to right while a circle expands from the center, creating an engaging morph-like animation. The button uses CSS transitions with custom cubic-bezier easing for fluid motion, transitioning from a transparent state to a solid dark fill with white text. Designed for modern web applications requiring polished interactive elements without visual complexity.
